body.name: Published OVS complete normal projection
body.construction:
For every \(u\in\{2,\ldots,T\}\) for which some finite \(g\in\mathcal G\) satisfies \(g\le u\), let \(\mathscr E_{\mathrm{OVS}}\) contain all nonzero rows indexed by \(e=(u,c,c')\) with distinct \(c,c'\in\mathcal C_u^{\mathrm{OVS}}\):
\[
\rho_e=e_{(c,1,u)}-e_{(c,0,u)}-e_{(c',1,u)}+e_{(c',0,u)}.
\]
Let \(\mathcal E_{\mathrm{OVS}}\) be the lexicographically first maximal linearly independent subcollection of these formal rows.  For \(e=(u,c,c')\in\mathcal E_{\mathrm{OVS}}\), set
\[
Z^{\mathrm{OVS}}_{e,P}(O)=
\frac{\mathbf 1_{c,1}}{p_{c,1}(X)}\{\Delta Y_u-m_{c,1,u}(X)\}
-\frac{\mathbf 1_{c,0}}{p_{c,0}(X)}\{\Delta Y_u-m_{c,0,u}(X)\}
-\frac{\mathbf 1_{c',1}}{p_{c',1}(X)}\{\Delta Y_u-m_{c',1,u}(X)\}
+\frac{\mathbf 1_{c',0}}{p_{c',0}(X)}\{\Delta Y_u-m_{c',0,u}(X)\},
\]
and stack these coordinates as \(Z_P^{\mathrm{OVS}}\).  With \(\psi_P^0\) from Definition \(\ref{def:complete-normal-projection}\), define
\[
K_{\mathrm{OVS},P}(X)=E_P[Z_P^{\mathrm{OVS}}Z_P^{\mathrm{OVS}\prime}\mid X],\qquad
r_{\mathrm{OVS},P}(X)=E_P[Z_P^{\mathrm{OVS}}\psi_P^0\mid X],
\]
\[
p_{\mathrm{OVS},P}=r_{\mathrm{OVS},P}(X)'K_{\mathrm{OVS},P}(X)^\dagger Z_P^{\mathrm{OVS}},\qquad
\phi_{\mathrm{OVS},P}=\psi_P^0-p_{\mathrm{OVS},P},\qquad
V_{\mathrm{OVS}}=E_P[\phi_{\mathrm{OVS},P}^2].
\]
Use zero-dimensional conventions when there is no nonzero OVS row, and set \(\Delta_{\mathrm{model}}=V_{\mathrm{can}}-V_{\mathrm{OVS}}\).
